Laura — reviewed ACME_Redlines_11102026.pdf and your summary. High-level guidance below; I added line items in the attached Word doc (legal_comments_msa.docx).

- Acceptable: most commercial redlines (pricing, payment term ask is typical).
- Needs negotiation: Data retention (Section 7) — we should propose a 2-year retention window with a one-time extension option for compliance review. The 3-year ask is long for our standard telemetry and audit logs.
- Indemnity: we can accept limited carve-outs for third-party connectors but will require a mutual limitation of liability to remain intact.
- Execution: we require evidence of authority if a delegated signer will sign on behalf of Acme (signed POA or board resolution). A signed email is sometimes acceptable but POA preferred.

Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope once you have confirmation of the signer and the attached comment items are resolved.

Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: legal_comments_msa.docx
